prepare_plug_charging_target.name: Prepare native target for Plug & Charge
prepare_plug_charging_target.description: Unplugged only. Sends duration, energy or budget without remote start. Wait for acceptance before plugging in.

schedule_charging_target.name: Reserve or repeat a native charging target
schedule_charging_target.description: One-time uses target + ReserveNow now and target + remote start at the selected time. Daily is managed and rearmed by Home Assistant.

cancel_scheduled_charging_target.name: Cancel scheduled charging target
cancel_scheduled_charging_target.description: Cancels a daily HA timer locally or sends CancelReservation for a one-time reservation. A native target already written to the charger is not cleared.

preview_charging_target.name: Preview native charging target
preview_charging_target.description: Read-only capture coverage and wire plan. Sends no commands.

value.name: Target value
value.description: Whole minutes, kWh or numeric charger-tariff units.

start.name: Start type
start.description: Now, one-time reservation or recurrence. Unverified combinations remain blocked.

start_charging_target.name: Start native charging target (experimental)
start_charging_target.description: Sends duration, energy or budget followed by remote start on captured firmware in Fast mode. Duration and energy stopping are verified; budget remains experimental. No automatic retries.

value.name: Target value
value.description: Guardrails: 1–1440 whole minutes, 0.01–100 kWh or 1–1000 tariff units.

confirm_experimental.name: Confirm supervised pilot
confirm_experimental.description: Accepted does not prove charging or target enforcement. Stay available to stop charging.

acknowledge_target_reset.name: Acknowledge independent native target reset
acknowledge_target_reset.description: Clears only the retained HA request, NOT the charger target. Does not send Cancel or Stop.

confirm_native_target_reset.name: Native target independently cleared
confirm_native_target_reset.description: Confirm the charger target is cleared and the next start is safe. A completed session alone does not prove a reset.

prepare_rfid_charging_target.name: Prepare native target for RFID
prepare_rfid_charging_target.description: Sets duration, energy or budget, never a remote start. Wait for target_accepted_waiting_for_rfid before presenting the card.

charging_target_status.name: Read charging target pilot status
charging_target_status.description: Read-only. Acceptance does not prove enforcement of the target.

menu_option_descriptions.general: Configura el intervalo de consulta y la ubicación.
menu_option_descriptions.energy_sources: Configura el flujo opcional de la batería para tarjetas y gráficos.
menu_option_descriptions.site_accounting: Account for EV energy and costs; optionally configure automatic charging stop.

general.title: Ajustes generales
general.description: Estos ajustes afectan a la conexión entre Home Assistant y el cargador.

data.poll_interval: Intervalo de consulta de la red (segundos, actualmente: {current_interval})

data_description.poll_interval: How often Home Assistant refreshes external power values.

energy_sources.title: Fuentes de energía opcionales
energy_sources.description: Solo para hogares con una batería compatible. Los valores se usan exclusivamente para la visualización y nunca controlan el cargador ni la batería. Deja el sensor sin seleccionar para desactivar esta función.

data.battery_power_entity: Sensor de potencia de la batería (opcional)
data.battery_power_sign: Convención de signo del sensor de batería

data_description.battery_power_entity: Selecciona un sensor de potencia en W, kW o MW para mostrar el flujo de la batería en la tarjeta.
data_description.battery_power_sign: Indica si un valor positivo representa carga o descarga.

site_accounting.title: Site EV accounting
site_accounting.description: La protección automática actúa solo en PV Linkage+ (solo excedente solar). Registre la energía y los costes del vehículo. La protección opcional detiene la carga tras un consumo sostenido de batería o red. Umbral y espera son configurables. Las lecturas ausentes o antiguas no provocan una parada. Sin reinicio automático.

data.site_fixed_price: Fixed price per kWh (used without price sensor)

data_description.site_stop_threshold_w: Potencia de la batería o de la red. Predeterminado: 500 W.
data_description.site_stop_hold_seconds: Predeterminado: 180 segundos. Si la producción solar actual cubre la carga, se conceden dos minutos adicionales para consumos domésticos temporales. Sin reinicio automático.
data_description.site_auto_stop_mode: La protección automática actúa solo en PV Linkage+ (solo excedente solar). Off, battery discharge, grid import, or either. Requires fresh readings and an active charging session; configure the battery source under Optional energy sources.

authorization.title: Local charging authorisation
authorization.description: Stored RFID identifiers: {count}. Physical card access and starts initiated by Home Assistant are managed independently. This does not change the charger's authorization mode, cards, or cloud bindings.

data.restrict_authorization: Restrict RFID access to the allowlist

data_description.restrict_authorization: Enables local checking of physical RFID identifiers. An enabled empty list rejects every card.
data_description.allow_ha_remote_start: Allows starts through HA controls, services, and automations. No technical identifier needs to be added to the RFID list.
data_description.authorized_id_tags: Up to 100 exact OCPP identifiers of 1–20 characters. The list is stored locally and shown again when this dialog opens. Delete a line to remove it; identifiers are omitted from normal logs and diagnostics.

confirm_charger_mode.title: ⚠️ Confirmar cambio del modo del cargador
confirm_charger_mode.description:
ADVERTENCIA: cambiar el modo reiniciará el THOR.

Después del reinicio puede ser necesario volver a conectar el vehículo para garantizar su correcto funcionamiento.

¿Quieres continuar?

state.details: Approximate time with actual energy transfer, accumulated from transaction MeterValues above 100 W. Energy-counter increases are used when power is unavailable; long reporting gaps are excluded. Historical sessions recorded before this feature remain unavailable.

state.details: PV Linkage cannot be selected while the charger reports PowerMeterFailure/485 Fault or after three consecutive external-meter requests receive no usable response. One or two temporary timeouts do not block the mode.
The operating mode controls which settings apply. Load balancing is available in Fast and Off-Peak mode, but not in PV Linkage mode.
Shows how charging sessions are authorized: Home Assistant/RFID, RFID only, or Plug & charge.
PV Linkage may supplement solar power with the configured grid allowance. PV Linkage+ uses only solar surplus. Manual and Smart Boost may still draw grid power.

solar_grid_import_limit.name: Consumo de red informado para PV Linkage

state.details: Maximum grid power the charger may add in PV Linkage mode. The retained value is not an active regular grid allowance in PV Linkage+. The charger requires about 1.4 kW single-phase or 4.1 kW three-phase to start.
Manual boost uses configured time windows; Smart boost uses target energy and finish time. The charger returns to PV Linkage after the boost.

grid_off_peak_charging.name: Carga desde la red en horas valle

state.details: Allows grid charging in the configured off-peak windows when Plug & charge authorization is active.
Enables charging during the configured off-peak windows in Off-Peak mode.
Lists the shared charger-side time windows. Depending on the working mode, Growatt uses them for Off-Peak charging or PV Linkage Manual Boost.

off_peak_current.name: Corriente de carga en horas valle

state.details: Charging current used during the configured off-peak windows.
External Modbus meter model used for grid measurements.
Modbus address of the external meter used for grid measurements.
Power meter uses direct Modbus measurements; CT modes use current transformers. Growatt calls the OCPP field 'wring', likely a vendor typo.

warm_up_after_full_charge.name: Precalentamiento informado tras la carga completa

state.details: After full charge, the charger may continue supplying a compatible EV for cabin or battery preheating and defrosting. Behavior depends on vehicle support.
Vendor charging delay in seconds. 0 means no delay. Random Delay behavior may vary by charger firmware.

Applies the complete changed PV Boost draft to the charger. Manual Boost sends its time window; Smart Boost sends finish time and target energy. The action is available only when the draft is complete, differs from the reported settings, and the charger is idle in PV Linkage mode.
Sets the grid-load limit used by load balancing. Available only with the Fast and Off-Peak charging strategies; unavailable in PV Linkage modes.
Modbus address of the external meter. Available only when Power meter is selected as the external sampling method and no charging transaction is active.

solar_grid_import_limit.name: Consumo de red para PV Linkage

state.details: Available only in PV Linkage mode, where regular grid import is allowed. It is unavailable in PV Linkage+, which uses solar surplus only. Decimal values are sent using dot notation.
Target energy for Smart Boost. This edits the local draft and is sent together with the finish time only after Apply is pressed.
PV Linkage allows the configured regular grid import; PV Linkage+ uses solar surplus only. Manual and Smart Boost may still draw grid power. Existing Boost targets and time windows are not changed.

Selects direct Modbus meter measurements or a CT 2000:1/3000:1 current transformer. Available only while no charging transaction is active. Growatt calls the OCPP key 'G_ExternalSamplingCurWring', likely a vendor typo.
Selects the external Modbus meter model. Available only when Power meter is selected as the external sampling method and no charging transaction is active.
Selects which Boost workflow to stage locally. Manual exposes a time window; Smart exposes finish time and target energy. No charger write occurs until Apply is pressed.

load_balancing.name: Equilibrio de carga (solo Carga rápida/Horas valle)

state.details: Prevents the configured grid-load limit from being exceeded. Available only with the Fast and Off-Peak charging strategies; unavailable in PV Linkage modes.
Allows a compatible vehicle to continue drawing power for preheating or defrosting after reaching full charge. Vehicle support is required.
Start of the staged Manual Boost window. Press Apply to send the complete window.
End of the staged Manual Boost window. Press Apply to send the complete window.

pv_smart_boost_finish.name: Hora de finalización de Smart Boost

state.details: Requested Smart Boost finish time. A time already passed today is scheduled for tomorrow when Apply is pressed.
